text: No burning was detected on the property during the period from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03. NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data, which includes observations from multiple sensors (VIIRS SNPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, and MODIS), showed zero detections intersecting the asset. The sensors provided complete coverage of the entire period and asset boundary. However, note that small, short-lived, or cloud-obscured fires may not always be detected. No evidence of burning is confirmed within the evaluated timeframe.
